description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Physical Mutation

Your neck thickens as your tongue becomes long, sinuous and ending in a sharp point - it extends down your throat to some hidden cavity in your chest. You can launch your tongue at opponents up to 4 yards away dealing SB Damage on a successful Ballistic Skill Test. Your tongue has the Precise Weapon Quality. Roll 1d10; on 9-10 you gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.gFkRm9wS65qe18Xv]{Venom (Average)} Creature Trait. I you have the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-mutations.items.Item.ZoRt8G8M0xyfdQpY]{Bloodsucker} Mutation you may lodge the tongue in your victim and cause 1 Wound per Round until the victim succeeds with an Opposed Strength Test or cuts o your tongue (which can sustain 2 Wounds). Your tongue will regrow at the rate of 2 inches per week if cut o. You can only gain this mutation once.
